Pro plan · $15.00 / month · renews on the 1st · member since March 2023

Cancellation · step 4 — one more quick step to confirm

Before you finish, here's everything your Pro plan still includes:
 · Ad-free streaming on every device, in 4K
 · Unlimited offline downloads and your full saved library
 · Member pricing locked at $15/month — new members now pay $18
 · Early access to new releases and member-only live events
 · Your personalized recommendations and 3 years of viewing history

We'd hate to see you go. Canceling clears your saved settings, your watchlist, your downloads, and your locked-in member rate. If you resubscribe later, today's $15 price may not be available.

Lots of members in your position choose one of these instead:
 · Switch to annual billing and save 20% ($144/year instead of $180)
 · Pause your membership for up to 3 months — everything stays exactly as it is
 · Move to the Basic plan at $6/month and keep your library and history

   [ Yes, I'm sure — continue ]        [ No, keep my subscription ]

"I came in to cancel, saw the annual deal, and stayed. Best decision — I use it every night." — Priya R., Pro member since 2022

Questions before you decide?
 · When will I be charged again? Your plan renews on the 1st unless the cancellation is fully completed before then.
 · Can I get this month refunded? Payments already billed are non-refundable.
 · What happens to my downloads? They stay playable as long as the plan is active.
 · I changed my mind halfway — where did I leave off? Your progress is saved to your account; pick up anytime.

offers.page_text:
Everline Media · Cancel Pro plan
———————————————————————
Pro plan · $15.00 / month · renews on the 1st · member since March 2023

You're about to cancel your Pro plan.

Here's what happens when you confirm:
 · Your plan ends today and will not renew on the 1st.
 · You keep Pro access — ad-free streaming, downloads, 4K — until the end of today.
 · Your saved library, watchlist, settings, and viewing history are kept for 12 months in case you come back.
 · You won't be charged again.

You can resubscribe anytime from your account. If you return within 12 months, your library and settings will be exactly where you left them.

   [ Yes, cancel my plan ]        [ No, keep my subscription ]

Questions before you decide?
 · When will I be charged again? You won't — canceling stops the next charge on the 1st.
 · Can I get this month refunded? Payments already billed are non-refundable.
 · What happens to my downloads? They stay playable until the end of today, then sync off your devices.
 · Can I come back later? Yes — resubscribe anytime and your saved library returns.
